about_the_game:
Step into an Epic Multiplayer Strategy Adventure

Step into a world of myths and legends in this deep new turn-based tactics game! Pick from 25 unique characters—including Dragons, Mermaids, Werewolves, Princesses and much more! Challenge friends in competitive multiplayer, dive into a rich story mode, or craft your own scenarios with the Story Maker. With endless ways to play, it’s your story to tell.

Tactical Combat with Wild Possibilities

  • Chain explosions with Goblins bombs and Elf archers.

  • Turn enemies into werewolves and build a feral army.

  • Use Prince Charming to seduce people to your side.

  • Protect your people with Dwarven walls while Scientists advance your technologies.

  • Transform characters into chickens with Witches and use Ninjas to finish them off

With 25 characters, the possibilities are endless—experiment and discover game-changing strategies that suit you best!

Pure Strategy, Menu-less Combat, No RNG

Streamlined gameplay. No scrolling through menus. No plans ruined by frustrating hit percentages—attacks always land. Every move counts! Unleash your creativity!

Easy to Learn, Deep to Master

Each character has intuitive abilities—Hercules hurls enemies, Treents spawn forests, and Prince Charming turns foes into allies. Find which of these abilities synergize with each other and unleash fast creative strategies on the battlefield!

Build Your Own Stories

Use the Story Maker to create Fire Emblem-style levels and scenarios. Save a princess from a dragon, guide characters to enlightenment with Buddha, follow Harriet Tubman on the Underground Railroad, and more. Bring your ideas to life and create stories with characters from around the world.

Try the Free Demo

Play with 12 characters, explore 12 story missions, battle online, and experiment with the Story Maker. Get a taste of the full Story Time adventure.

Play Anywhere

Enjoy local and online multiplayer. Battle friends worldwide, and then get together and play on the couch with your friends

Join A new Era of Turn Based Tactics

Revolutionize the way you play multiplayer tactical games—wishlist today and be part of the journey!

short_description: Multiplayer PvP Tactics game. Choose 9 characters. Play with your friends. The player with the most characters wins. Includes local and online multiplayer. Also includes a Story Mode and a Level Editor. Create your own stories. Play them with the world!
